REPORT

Special Branch Station File No. Date August 11, 1941.

SUBJECT: Miss L.A. Nikolaeff - Antecedents and character.

Miss Lydia Alexandrovna NIKOLAEFF, Russian, was born on March 20, 1911 at Station Mandaphedzy, Chinese Eastern Railway. She is reported to have received her education at the Mandaochedzy Middle School, upon leaving which in 1929 she resided in Harbin until November, 1934 when she proceeded to Shanghai. It appears that she travelled on a Soviet passport and that upon arrival in Shanghai she renounced her Soviet citizenship and took out emigrant papers through the medium of the Russian Emigrants Committee.

In 1935 she was absent from Shanghai to Harbin, returning here in November of the same year.

In Shanghai she resided at various addresses in the French Concession and Settlement, including 404 Avenue Joffre, Apt. 2, Lane 220 Kungping Road, House 37 and 126 Baikal Road.

She is not known to have any fixed employment while in Shanghai and is believed to have been supported by Warder J.V. Bourmakin. At least they have been openly living as husband and wife for the past several years.

Miss Nikolaeff did not come to Police notice while in Shanghai and nothing detrimental to her character is known by this office.

Her mother and brother are reported to reside at Harbin.

A. Prokopieff
D. I.

A. C. ( Special Branch ).

报告

特务科分站档案号 日期：1941年8月11日。

主题：L.A. 尼古拉耶夫小姐 - 背景及品行。

莉迪亚·亚历山德罗夫娜·尼古拉耶夫（Lydia Alexandrovna NIKOLAEFF）小姐，俄国人，1911年3月20日出生于中东铁路曼达费季站（Station Mandaphedzy）。据报，她曾在曼道切季中学（Mandaochedzy Middle School）接受教育，1929年离校后居住于哈尔滨，直至1934年11月前往上海。据悉，她持苏联护照旅行，抵达上海后放弃了苏联国籍，并通过俄国侨民委员会办理了侨民证件。

1935年，她离开上海前往哈尔滨，并于同年11月返回上海。

在上海期间，她曾居住于法租界及公共租界的多个地址，包括霞飞路404号2室、公平路220弄、贝加尔路37号及126号。

在上海期间，未发现她有固定职业，据信由狱警 J.V. 布尔马金（Warder J.V. Bourmakin）供养。至少在过去几年里，他们公开以夫妻名义共同生活。

尼古拉耶夫小姐在上海期间未引起警方注意，本处亦不知晓任何有损其品行之事。

据报，其母亲和兄弟居住在哈尔滨。

A. 普罗科皮耶夫（A. Prokopieff）
情报调查员（D. I.）

助理主任（特务科）。
